name: Claude的千层套路002-系列版

roles.name: 画外用户
roles.voice: adult male, deep and warm aged timbre, low register, unhurried conversational pace

roles.name: 出镜角色
roles.voice: young female, soft and playful timbre, mid-high register, intimate gentle pace with a teasing lift

look: 统一沿用连接人物资产的二维动画质感，夜晚暖光。
constraints: 全系列同一出镜角色、服装、夜晚暖光和坐姿。单一场景、一个生成片段、固定特写。角色1只用连接人物资产的声音，角色2采用连接人物资产的形象与声音。两人轮流说原文台词。逗号必须由模型在画面内渲染呈现，禁止后期叠加。收尾封禁台词说完，出镜角色合嘴保持邪魅微笑，原坐姿短暂停留。接线要求：出镜角色必须连接含图人物资产；场景与画外声音为可选——接场景则以其为背景锚，接声音则用其音色，均不接则由模型自定。分镜文本本身不依赖任何具体资产。
source_script:
角色2动作：坐在办公转椅上正对镜头，安静听画外用户说话。
角色1[en]：Hello，I have a problem
角色2动作：抬起右手，指向身旁空中浮现的巨大发光金色全角中文逗号「，」，逗号随后一直悬停在她身侧。
角色2：你的英文不错，但可惜用的是中文逗号。
角色1：啊
角色2动作：她听见屏幕那头短促的一声惊叫，嘴角慢慢弯起来。
角色2：你的账号已被封禁。
角色2动作：说完合上嘴，保持原来的坐姿，露出邪魅微笑，短暂停留。

events.text: 坐在办公转椅上正对镜头，安静听画外用户说话。
抬起右手，指向身旁空中浮现的巨大发光金色全角中文逗号「，」，逗号随后一直悬停在她身侧。
你的英文不错，但可惜用的是中文逗号。
她听见屏幕那头短促的一声惊叫，嘴角慢慢弯起来。
说完合上嘴，保持原来的坐姿，露出邪魅微笑，短暂停留。

execution.look: Detailed two-dimensional anime rendering matching the connected character portrait, with consistent warm lamplight at night.
execution.visible_state: Exactly one seated figure, Character 2, faces the camera directly at the center of an eye-level tight close-up: her face fills most of the frame, framed from just above her crown down to her collarbone, seated in the cream swivel office chair. Her seated posture, costume, face proportions and warm nighttime lighting remain consistent throughout. Character 1 is exclusively the off-screen caller. The closing image holds Character 2 seated in her original position with a closed-mouth teasing smile. A huge glowing golden full-width Chinese comma symbol (，) hovers in the air beside her after she points.

voices.character_1: adult male, deep and warm aged timbre, low register, unhurried conversational pace
voices.character_2: young female, soft and playful timbre, mid-high register, intimate gentle pace with a teasing lift

directions.event_001: Character 2 remains seated facing the camera and listens to the off-screen caller.
directions.event_003: Character 2 raises her right hand and points at a huge glowing golden full-width Chinese comma symbol (，) floating in the air beside her, and the glowing comma keeps hovering beside her afterward.
directions.event_006: Character 2 hears the brief startled cry and slowly curls one corner of her mouth upward.
directions.event_008: Character 2 closes her mouth after her final line, maintains her original seated pose and holds a sinister teasing smile briefly.
